items.title: An m-regular coherent sheaf on projective space is globally generated after twisting by m
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that an m-regular coherent sheaf F on projective n-space has F(m) globally generated. The proof uses the standard fact that F(d) is globally generated for all sufficiently large d, chooses d >= m with that property, and picks a basis f_1, ..., f_r of H^0(P^n, F) (proof lines 6750-6754). The multiplication lemma then expresses every element of H^0(P^n, F(d)) as a sum of products P_i f_i with homogeneous P_i of degree d - m; since the sections of F(d) generate F(d), it follows that the sections f_i generate F(m) (proof lines 6755-6759). H2: the choice of the auxiliary d and the transfer of generation from the twist to the m-th twist are the substance.
